title: PROTECTION PRAYER
GENESIS 15:1
end: The Covenant Shield — daily protection prayer

scenes.a: When fear rises before the day begins, remember the Lord’s words to Abram and bring your concerns to Him.
Genesis chapter fifteen, verse one says, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
The Lord invites us to trust His presence, not merely our own strength or our ability to see what lies ahead.
Heavenly Father, be near to every listener who feels uncertain, vulnerable, or overwhelmed by the journey ahead.
Give us wisdom to make careful choices, courage to ask for help, and peace to take the next faithful step.
In every trial, remind us that Your love is not absent, and teach us to rest in Your faithfulness.
Type Amen and subscribe to The Covenant Shield for daily prayer and encouragement in God’s keeping.
